title: Three campers frozen and abducted at a lake
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of Three campers frozen and abducted at a lake, about unspecified at a lake (unspecified), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And this one um this one event that I got the record of, there were three guys camping at a lake and they it was nighttime.

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, speaking on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, says he once saw the record of an event in classified study materials. According to that record, three men were camping at a lake one night when they were frozen in place and taken away by something not human. Buchanan doesn't say when or where this happened, but he tells it as a case that ended up in official files, which would mean someone in government was keeping track of abductions.
